source: The layout builder's data (BUILD_PLAN 6, step 3, 2026-11-09). Every entry says where it came from. Entries with status "proposed" are this session's reading and wait for the owner's yes (DECISIONS "AI designer: layout builder").

max_appliance_move.source: Owner, 2026-11-09 (chat): appliances can move several inches to a couple of feet, only to improve the design, and each move is explained; 24" chosen in the plan review. Along the appliance's own wall only.

ends.source: DECISIONS 2026-11-07 "The cabinet catalog": Unfinished beside a wall or cabinet (with a filler at every wall); an open end gets an Applied finished end by default. Design rule CB-FACT-10.

drawer_over_doors.source: Catalog: a drawer over doors; intake drawer level "Minimum": a drawer on top of every base cabinet.

bank_3.source: Catalog: three-drawer base; intake drawer levels name banks of 3.

bank_4.source: Catalog: four-drawer base; intake drawer levels name banks of 4.

sink_base.source: Catalog: sink base (DECISIONS 2026-11-07, sink base default).

garbage.source: Catalog: "A drawer over a pull-out for a double garbage can."

base_filler.source: Catalog; DECISIONS 2026-11-07: fillers are 3/4" wide by default; a filler at every wall (CB-FACT-10).

tall_filler.source: Catalog; as base_filler, for talls and pantries.

uppers.source: Catalog: the two standard upper heights (30" and 36"). Which suits the room is weighed as an option, not decided here.

fridge_upper.source: Catalog: "A short upper with no shelf, for example over a fridge." Its 24" depth has no catalog item yet (DECISIONS AD-1).

cooking_upper.source: Owner, 2026-11-09: a cabinet can go over a range or cooktop instead of a hood. Catalog: "A short upper with no shelf". Which cabinet the shop uses there is not confirmed.

wall_oven.source: Catalog: "A drawer at the bottom, an open space for a wall oven, and doors on top."

corner_inserts.source: This session's reading of the catalog for the intake's corner answer (no mapping existed). Lazy Susan: the L-shaped corner base (door on the inside corner), where a carousel sits. Double shelf: the same L-shaped base with adjustable shelves. Both are L-shaped, so a corner always has access (PREF-033). For the owner to confirm.

drawer_levels.source: The intake's own option wording (src/modules/intake/data/intake-v1.json, owner-reviewed prototype, 2026-11-08). Minimum: "A drawer on top of every base cabinet, one bank of 4 drawers and one bank of 3." Moderate: "About 60–70% of base cabinets are drawer banks: two banks of 4, the rest banks of 3." Maximum: "Drawers in every base cabinet." Drawer banks are made in 30" only until the shop gives their limits (CAT-1).

moderate.note: Which type the 30–40% that are not banks get is not said; a drawer over doors is used (at least as many drawers as Minimum).

maximum.note: Cabinets that can't be a 30" bank get a drawer over doors, so every base has drawers.

ranking.source: This session's reading of the owner's strength words (design rules), for shortlisting options and for when the AI can't be reached. Hard rules are never broken; then the fewest broken preferences of the strongest wording; then the fewest of the rest.
